technical_cap_purpose: anti_abuse_input_sanity_only_not_gameplay_level_cap; far above any achievable equipment bonus so no normal effective rank is ever truncated

probability_cap.roll_policy: roll_bound = min(raw_bound, roll_space); probability = min(raw_probability, max)

denominator_floor.policy: proc_denominator = max(last_delta_linear_extension, min); stops decreasing at 2

summon_pet_level_cap.policy: existing summon combat level cap preserved; initial pet level = min(effective_rank, max)

timing_constant.policy: cooldown/cast timing and pet timing stay at base_rank_max values; effective level never changes release timing
